sources.title: rahulpatelford/coca-matching-playground · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Coca for Matching. The tiny configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.
